reviews.comment: I have been teaching assistant for Professor Birdwell and have taken his class as well. He gives his immense buisness insights and experience when he teaches very often which is something i can keep for lifetime now.

Without a doubt the best professor Ive had in all of construction science. I have used almost all of what he taught me in the real world. Hes a great guy who really cares about his students success. Would take again if I could

Easiest COSC class at tamu. Homework is super easy and doable within a reasonable amount of time and he reads straight from the test on review day. 100% the professor to take for 175. He knows a ton about the business and isn't afraid to let you know. Pretty entertaining class actually.

Birdwell has a lot of experience and an ego to match it. He knows what he's talking about but has a tendency to ramble. His lectures are straight from the book so reading helps. He reviews for the tests really well and is almost always in his office. Do the homework. They're easy points. Utilize office hours to. He appreciates that.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS
